steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.body: Mix together **1 × 15 oz can pumpkin puree**, **1 can evaporated milk**, **3 eggs**, slightly beaten, **½ cup sugar**, **2 tsp cinnamon** and **½ tsp nutmeg**.

steps.title: Add the topping
steps.body: Sprinkle over top of mixture: **1 cake mix (yellow, lemon, or spice)** and **1 cup chopped nuts**.

steps.title: Drizzle butter
steps.body: Drizzle over top: **½ cup butter**, melted.
